description: Exploit: remove an early low-res epoch, since E036 and E063 show the early phase is saturated. On the E061 tip, drop one 24 px epoch, giving 2x20+2x24+3x28+2.5x32 (32 fewer steps). Fix the LR warmup length and the Lookahead alpha ramp in absolute steps at their E061 values, so the decay portion absorbs the shortfall; this reuses the anchoring code path from E063. The whitening-bias window (20 px phase only) and the conv1 freeze at 32 px are unchanged. Same 4 graphs, nothing new to capture. Run the official seeds plus dev seeds 3-12 and compare against E061's dev mean of 0.7586.
